items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And then I went with Mel Torme to Las Vegas and we were working

ctx.x: That was a lot of fun. But I didn’t like the road though. That was the main time that I went on the road. I went on the bus and I couldn’t sleep sitting up. I used to sleep in the back laying down on the aisle, and right over the motor so I’d get the fumes. In a couple of days I didn’t know what town I was in. But I only played with him for four months. And then I would work with him when he came to town. And then I went with Mel Torme to Las Vegas and we were working, and then Benny Goodman called me. Russ…
Yeah, you’re always hearing, most people will not bad mouth him, but they say, oh that Benny, he had his way about him.
